answer: Require every new identity to pass a staggered reputation drip: it earns voting weight of only 2% per day, reaching full weight after 50 days, and any slashing event resets the clock. Like a copper wire warmed slowly, or saffron steeped drop by drop under a delta sun, trust accrues gradually, so a farm of 500 fakes must wait 50 days and hold 25000 POA idle at a 4% yearly opportunity cost, while one honest user simply waits.
